## The Top Channels in the Travel Category in Italy

Content published by the YouTube channel Nicolò Balini (@safariumano) produced 1M views in October 2026. With this high number, the Travel channel in Italy ranked 1st on our list. The YouTuber has 1.4M subscribers, and their videos garnered 25.1K likes and 567 comments as well.

Taking the 2nd place is Giovanni Fois (@giovannifois) with 129.5K views. The channel managed to collect 1.2M subscribers, and their videos had 3K likes and 67 comments.

HumanSafari (@humansafari) got 3rd position on our ranking. The Travel channel’s videos were viewed by 515.3K on average and received 13.9K likes and 198 comments.

On the 4th place, you’ll find THE PILLOW (@the.pillow). Boasting a 989K subscriber list, their content generated 581.8K views, 10.1K likes, and 785 comments.

Cicalone Simone (@cicalone) landed 5th on our top list with 168.6K views. The Travel channel in Italy has 914.5K subscribers and gathered 2.5K likes and 468 comments on average last month.
